albumIdentity.scope: Read-only generated database observation and matching implementation of the installed native library; no UI deduplication or new grouping policy is implemented.

queries.albums: select a.id_album,a.title,a.artist_id,r.name,a.nb_tracks,a.release_year,a.nb_discs from Album a left join Artist r on a.artist_id=r.id_artist order by a.id_album
queries.tracks: select m.id_media,m.type,m.title,m.artist_id,m.album_id,m.track_number,m.disc_number,f.name as folder from Media m join Folder f on m.folder_id=f.id_folder where m.album_id is not null order by m.id_media
queries.genres: select id_genre,name,nb_tracks from Genre order by name

albumIdentity.conclusion: Two separate native album IDs, each with one track in a different folder and the same album artist. No year/disc tags were supplied. Native matching deliberately rejects this cross-folder match; the UI is displaying both identities.

accepted: Shared artist header exposes native album/track model counts, navigation, search, sort and view. Traditional artist details retain their original custom header; its search binding is only instantiated in that layout.

Single artist table Enter now navigates without requesting playback, matching grid behavior. Explicit Play and multi-selection playback retain native routes. Ordinary fixed Enter preserves initial paused video0; banner Tab navigation reaches Play/Enqueue/tracks without a hidden control stop.

Keyboard Space on Enqueue appends the two actual artist tracks after two videos without playing. Explicit Space Play appends/starts the correct artist tracks, reaches9s and pauses at16.704405s. Artist switch, track search, clear, Back/Forward, grid count, genre navigation and album expansion retain that exact held clock and six-entry queue.

Genre details expose Music/Genres/Electronic breadcrumbs. Missing-year album caption shows artist, track count and duration without doubled separators. Traditional table Enter preserves paused video0; custom search filters/clears, grid shows one native album, and explicit Play advances First light before normal Pause/Quit.

Eight native query functions pass on the unchanged Core265/library282. Album identities, track types/order/search, artist/genre parents and paging are verified. Legacy criterion fails only the intended media-track negative control. Native source matching and a hash-unchanged read-only generated database explain the two separate Evening Album IDs.
limits: Only the two GUI290 runs are accepted for this detail checkpoint. The GUI289 table Enter failure is retained and repaired; no claim is made that its first unmeasured journey preserved paused playback.

Return on the focused ordinary banner button did not enqueue; Space is the observed standard activation. Warm observation04 records that attempt; observation05 is misleadingly named four-queue-items but actually shows the original two. The later observation06 supplies the actual four-entry enqueue result.

Some immediate UIA trees lag rendered transitions. One indexed Search click after queue reflow missed the field; a screenshot-backed click with a visible caret and real typing supplied the accepted filter observation. No claim of complete assistive-technology geometry or focus feedback is made.

Equal album titles are distinct native identities when cross-folder matching lacks year/multi-disc evidence. No UI deduplication or library grouping policy was changed. Year-present caption formatting keeps its original branch; this fixture tests missing year.

The multi-selection artist branch is preserved by code review, but not exercised in these ordinary runs. Full rapid in-flight A-B-A, all category sort permutations, search-history retention, initial empty sort feedback, final visual scores, Windows DPI, media matrix and package gates remain open.
